answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 260 fakes pays 173 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. One key, one wait — the queue cannot be jumped by paying more. What carries the yarrow here is verification, the ridge of cost is what stops the farm, and the copper of the record keeps every claim checkable. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
